## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh exists and is executable. Verify: `test -x tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script invokes create-dso-app.sh (or its installer entry point) in a temp directory derived from $RUNNER_TEMP with mktemp fallback. Verify: `grep -E 'RUNNER_TEMP|mktemp' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script patches the bootstrapped project's .claude/dso-config.conf to set merge.strategy=pr AND model.provider=anthropic (OpenAI quota is exhausted as of 2026-05-01 — must use Anthropic). Verify: `grep -E 'merge.strategy=pr' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh && grep -E 'model.provider=anthropic' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script asserts prerequisites and FAILs loudly when missing: gh auth status, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY exported, create-dso-app.sh exit 0. Verify: `grep -E 'gh auth status|ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] Test script is idempotent: re-running when the temp project already exists skips bootstrap and only re-applies the config patch. Verify: `grep -E 'idempotent|already exists|skip bootstrap' tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh`
- [ ] .test-index has a RED marker entry: `tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch]`. Verify: `grep -F 'tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh [test_host_bootstrap_and_config_patch]' .test-index`
- [ ] Test passes when run with valid prereqs and fails fast with a clear message when prereqs are missing.

## File Impact

- tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-bootstrap.sh (NEW)
- .test-index (MODIFIED — add RED marker)
